# @imrieul/mysql-mcp服务器

[韩语](https://github.com/ImRieul/mysql-mcp-server/blob/main/README.ko.md) | [日本语](https://github.com/ImRieul/mysql-mcp-server/blob/main/README.ja.md) | [中文](https://github.com/ImRieul/mysql-mcp-server/blob/main/README.zh.md) | [西班牙语](https://github.com/ImRieul/mysql-mcp-server/blob/main/README.es.md) | [葡萄牙语](https://github.com/ImRieul/mysql-mcp-server/blob/main/README.pt.md) | [法语](https://github.com/ImRieul/mysql-mcp-server/blob/main/README.fr.md) | [俄语](https://github.com/ImRieul/mysql-mcp-server/blob/main/README.ru.md)

一个简单的MySQL [主控程序](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) 服务器。

## 特性

- **LLM友好** --紧凑的列/行格式、自动LIMIT、错误提示和下一步操作建议
- **批量架构** — `describe_all_tables` 在一次调用中返回整个数据库模式
- **只读模式** --应用程序级前缀检查+DB级 `SET SESSION TRANSACTION READ ONLY`
- **查询超时** — `Promise.race()` 基于超时，保证连接清理
- **SSL支持** --一个env变量来启用加密连接
- **最小化** --3个依赖项，无需配置

## 快速开始

添加到MCP配置(`.mcp.json` 或 `claude_desktop_config.json`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mysql": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@imrieul/mysql-mcp-server"],
      "env": {
        "MYSQL_HOST": "localhost",
        "MYSQL_PORT": "3306",
        "MYSQL_USER": "root",
        "MYSQL_PASSWORD": "your-password",
        "MYSQL_DATABASE": "your-database"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

或者使用连接字符串：

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mysql": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@imrieul/mysql-mcp-server", "mysql://root:password@localhost:3306/mydb"]
    }
  }
}
```

### 法典

Codex使用TOML配置，而不是 `mcpServers` JSON。将此添加到 `~/.codex/config.toml` 或项目范围 `.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
[mcp_servers.mysql]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@imrieul/mysql-mcp-server"]

[mcp_servers.mysql.env]
MYSQL_HOST = "localhost"
MYSQL_PORT = "3306"
MYSQL_USER = "root"
MYSQL_PASSWORD = "your-password"
MYSQL_DATABASE = "your-database"
```

### 开放代码

将此添加到 `opencode.json` 或 `opencode.jsonc`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "mysql": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["npx", "-y", "@imrieul/mysql-mcp-server"],
      "enabled": true,
      "environment": {
        "MYSQL_HOST": "localhost",
        "MYSQL_PORT": "3306",
        "MYSQL_USER": "root",
        "MYSQL_PASSWORD": "your-password",
        "MYSQL_DATABASE": "your-database"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 带SSL的只读模式

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mysql": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@imrieul/mysql-mcp-server", "--readonly"],
      "env": {
        "MYSQL_HOST": "db.example.com",
        "MYSQL_USER": "readonly_user",
        "MYSQL_PASSWORD": "password",
        "MYSQL_DATABASE": "production",
        "MYSQL_SSL": "true",
        "MYSQL_QUERY_TIMEOUT": "10000"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## 工具

|工具|描述|只读模式|
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `query` |执行选择、显示、描述、解释|允许|
| `execute` |执行INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE、DDL |已阻止|
| `list_databases` |列出所有数据库|允许|
| `list_tables` |列出数据库中的表|允许|
| `describe_table` |显示表架构|允许|
| `describe_all_tables` |一次显示所有表架构|允许|

## 配置

### 环境变量

|变量|必填|默认|描述|
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `MYSQL_HOST` |是|--|MySQL主机|
| `MYSQL_USER` |是|--|MySQL用户|
| `MYSQL_PASSWORD` |是|--|MySQL密码|
| `MYSQL_PORT` |没有| `3306` |MySQL端口|
| `MYSQL_DATABASE` |否|--|默认数据库|
| `MYSQL_READONLY` |没有| `false` |只读模式|
| `MYSQL_MAX_ROWS` |没有| `100` |SELECT查询的自动限制|
| `MYSQL_QUERY_TIMEOUT` |没有| `30000` |查询超时（毫秒）（0表示禁用）|
| `MYSQL_SSL` |没有| `false` |启用SSL连接|

### 连接字符串

```
mysql://user:password@host:port/database
```

作为第一个CLI参数传递。优先于环境变量。
